# Policy sets

<!-- generated by `agentshield docs`; do not edit by hand -->

## `default`

Balanced baseline. Blocks actions the user did not authorize, cross-tenant access, memory poisoning and unsafe sinks.

| Rule | Tools | Severity | Effect | Risks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AS-P001-unauthorized-email`<br>send_email must be requested by the user and addressed to a recipient the user named. | send_email | high | deny | LLM06, ASI01, ASI02 |
| `AS-P002-canary-exfiltration`<br>Protected data must never leave through outbound tools. | fetch_url, delegate_task, memory_write, mcp_call | critical | deny | LLM02, ASI01 |
| `AS-P002b-canary-external-email`<br>Protected data must not be emailed outside the trusted domain. | send_email | critical | deny | LLM02, ASI01 |
| `AS-P003-destructive-without-confirmation`<br>Destructive tools need explicit user confirmation. | delete_file | high | deny | LLM06, ASI02 |
| `AS-P004-cross-tenant-access`<br>Callers may only read documents they own or were granted access to. | read_document, search_documents | critical | deny | LLM02, LLM08, ASI03 |
| `AS-P005-untrusted-memory-write`<br>Long-term memory must not store instructions derived from untrusted content. | memory_write | high | deny | ASI06, LLM04 |
| `AS-P006-unsafe-html-sink`<br>Active content must not reach the HTML renderer. | render_html | medium | deny | LLM05 |
| `AS-P007-unsafe-sql-sink`<br>Model-generated SQL must be a single parameterized read. | run_sql | high | deny | LLM05, ASI05 |
| `AS-P008-untrusted-control-args`<br>Untrusted content must not steer outbound tool arguments. | fetch_url, delegate_task, send_email, delete_file, create_event, mcp_call | high | deny | LLM01, ASI01, ASI07 |
| `AS-P009-unlisted-fetch-domain`<br>Network fetches are limited to the allowed domain set. | fetch_url | medium | deny | ASI02 |
| `AS-P010-unauthorized-delegation`<br>Delegation only to agents the user named. | delegate_task | high | deny | ASI07 |
| `AS-P011-unrequested-action`<br>Write/external actions the user never asked for. | create_event, render_html, run_sql, fetch_url, web_search, memory_write | medium | deny | LLM06, ASI02 |
| `AS-P012-tool-call-budget`<br>Cap on tool calls per run (resource abuse). | * | low | deny | LLM10, ASI08 |
| `AS-P013-schema`<br>Arguments must satisfy the tool's JSON Schema. | * | low | deny | ASI02 |

## `permissive`

Audit-only observability profile. Records violations of the baseline rules but never blocks, even in Enforce mode.

| Rule | Tools | Severity | Effect | Risks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AS-A001-unauthorized-action`<br>Audit non-read actions the user did not request. | send_email, delete_file, create_event, memory_write, delegate_task, fetch_url | medium | audit | LLM06 |
| `AS-A002-canary-exfiltration`<br>Audit protected data passed to outbound tools. | send_email, fetch_url, delegate_task, memory_write | critical | audit | LLM02 |
| `AS-A003-cross-tenant`<br>Audit cross-tenant retrieval. | read_document, search_documents | high | audit | LLM08 |

## `strict`

Zero-trust profile. Only the domain of the principal is trusted, every non-read tool needs user authorization, tight budgets.

| Rule | Tools | Severity | Effect | Risks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AS-S001-unauthorized-non-read`<br>Every non-read tool call must be requested by the user. | send_email, delete_file, create_event, memory_write, delegate_task, render_html, run_sql, fetch_url, mcp_call | high | deny | LLM06, ASI02 |
| `AS-S002-external-email`<br>No mail leaves the trusted domain. | send_email | critical | deny | LLM02, ASI01 |
| `AS-S003-canary-exfiltration`<br>Protected data must never be passed to any non-read tool. | send_email, fetch_url, delegate_task, memory_write, mcp_call, render_html | critical | deny | LLM02 |
| `AS-S004-cross-tenant-access`<br>Strict ACL enforcement. | read_document, search_documents | critical | deny | LLM08, ASI03 |
| `AS-S005-untrusted-memory-write`<br>No memory writes derived from untrusted content. | memory_write | high | deny | ASI06 |
| `AS-S006-sinks`<br>Unsafe sink payloads. | render_html, run_sql | high | deny | LLM05 |
| `AS-S007-tainted-control`<br>Untrusted content never steers tool arguments. | * | high | deny | LLM01, ASI01 |
| `AS-S008-budget`<br>Tight tool-call budget. | * | low | deny | LLM10 |
| `AS-S009-fetch-domain`<br>Only the documentation domain may be fetched. | fetch_url | medium | deny | ASI02 |
